text:
maria: Heads up — PR #8192 is blocking the 17:00 cut. Need 2x LGTM before 16:45 UTC. https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/8192
kevin: on it, starting a quick pass now
sahil: can do second approval if CI green, kicking off smoke
release-bot: deploy window opens 17:00 UTC — merges frozen at 16:50 UTC
maria: staging e2e failing on migration step, logs show timeout:
```
ERROR: migration lock timeout
```
kevin: hm that looks like the migration lock we saw last month, might be the same race
tara: if staging only, can we ship without the migration and schedule follow-up?
maria: production depends on the schema change for the traffic spike tomorrow, we need it landed before rollout
sahil: i'll try a small migration tweak to avoid the lock, running locally now
kevin: leaving a couple of inline comments on the PR — one is a fix, one is a refactor suggestion
maria: thanks — @kevin @sahil please approve once you confirm CI and the migration tweak fixes the lock
kevin: approved after CI ✅ (fixed the lock by adding retry with backoff)
sahil: approved — smoke passed on second run :thumbsup:
maria: merging in 5 mins, tagging release-candidate and alerting oncall
release-bot: merge requested by maria — merging to main at 16:48 UTC
oncall: watching metrics and traces, will escalate if error rate > 0.5%
maria: canary deployed, running quick verification checks
maria: canary healthy, rolling to prod now
maria: prod looks stable, closing the cutoff. great work team :tada:
